annotations.title: start a withPICA signup (sends a magic link to verify email)

description: [settings] Sign up for withPICA from inside the agent, without leaving the chat. Use this when the user wants to create a new withPICA account / catalog and you're talking to them through an unauthenticated MCP connection (stdio without an API key, or HTTP without a Bearer token). The tool mints a single-use signup link valid for 15 minutes — surface the URL to the user as a clickable resource_link. The link opens a page that verifies their email by magic-link, creates their organisation, starts their free runway (a non-expiring usage allowance — no day-count trial), and (for stdio) shows a connection key to paste into Claude Desktop's MCP config or (for HTTP) resumes the OAuth flow. For existing users, prefer pica_sign_in.

email.description: The user's email address. The signup link is sent to this inbox; the user clicks it to verify ownership before any account is created. Required.

org_name.description: Optional human name for the user's catalog/organisation. Defaults to '<email-localpart>'s catalog' if omitted. Editable later in settings.

purpose.description: Optional free-text — what the user is trying to do with PICA, captured for product analytics (e.g. 'managing my first album credits', 'exporting royalty statements'). Not surfaced to the user.

referral_code.description: Optional referral code from an existing withPICA user who invited this person (their `?ref=` code, shown in Settings → invite & earn). When supplied, the signup is attributed to that referrer and both sides receive bonus credits on completion. Omit if the user has no invite code.

name: pica_signup_start
